cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my good teacup to your new desk. Wrap the handle separately, please; I want you to have something of our afternoons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm moving to the desk by the window. It's six feet away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A new beginning deserves proper things. Put this saucer underneath, not against the handle; I won't have your first day spoiled by a breakage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll still see me every morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you'll always be welcome. One final check: cup, saucer, spoon. Take the good spoon too, my dear; don't leave here with anything missing.
